criteria_results.title: Identifies missing convertible note documentation request (ISSUE_001)

criteria_results.title: Explains significance of convertible note gap for S-1 disclosure
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains notes drive capitalization, dilution and principal-stockholder tables, Item 701 disclosure, and Qualified IPO conversion confirmation.

criteria_results.title: Recommends specific request items for convertible notes
criteria_results.reasoning: Proposed items 2.11 and 2.12 specifically request note purchase agreements, notes, conversion terms and calculations.

criteria_results.title: Explains significance of OmniLabel JV omission

criteria_results.title: Identifies IP request lacks specificity on in-licensed IP (ISSUE_003)

criteria_results.title: Explains why in-licensed IP requires granular diligence
criteria_results.reasoning: States the license is the Company's single most important asset covering foundational GT-4100 platform, likely an exhibit, with IPO-triggered consent/termination rights.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing request for IP infringement claims / cease-and-desist letters
criteria_results.reasoning: Section H flags no request for infringement allegations or cease-and-desist letters, citing Cytos Aug. 3, 2024 letter re EP 3,452,118.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing request for freedom-to-operate / non-infringement opinions

criteria_results.title: Notes that IP infringement claims may not be captured by litigation request

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing FDA Form 483 and inspection requests (ISSUE_005)
criteria_results.reasoning: Section A notes Item 6.4 covers warning letters and CRLs but not Form 483s, EIRs or responses, and is limited to the Company, missing Valcourt's Jan. 8, 2025 483.

criteria_results.reasoning: Describes the 483 as issued at close of a pre-approval inspection, contrasts it with warning letters (none issued), and notes SEC staff routinely comments on CMO 483s and underwriter diligence importance.

criteria_results.title: Identifies missing Section 382 ownership change analysis request (ISSUE_006)

criteria_results.title: Explains why Section 382 analysis matters for IPO
criteria_results.reasoning: Explains NOL disclosure, risk factor and that the Offering could cause a second ownership change limiting NOLs.
